description: Machine learning finds patterns in examples. Learn inputs, labels, simple predictions and fair checks using tiny lists of numbers that you can follow by hand. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
